currentState: Chapter 7: courteous and unequal in energy. Havel is solicitous ('My lady. Sit, please. You look done in.'); Jaina is polite and direct and then, at the table, turns his own plan against him with two questions ('what's left in the loft?', 'Where is the crock by the time your clerk gets there?') and sets her staff down beside Sylvanas to face him.
powerDynamic: Havel defers on arrival and treats her as a visiting lady to be seated; at the table she out-argues his plan and sides with Sylvanas's tempo. He does not argue back to her.

physicalDynamics.pattern: Havel looks past Sylvanas to Jaina in the doorway, tells her to sit; Jaina sits on Corin's stool, staff heel on the floor. At the table Jaina comes round the table end and faces him across Sylvanas's shoulder.

Chapter 7: Jaina asks 'When your men close the row, what's left in the loft?' and 'The crock. Where is the crock by the time your clerk gets there?'; Corin answers 'Washed out. Or in the weir.'
